_comment: Sink record-signing envelope aleutian.proof.record.v2 (docs/sink-format.md §9.1): the exact bytes an ML-DSA-65 record signature over a chain-format-v4 entry covers. Domain "aleutian.proof.record.v2" then 0x00, then nine fields in fixed order, each tag (1 byte) || length (uint32 big-endian) || ASCII value: 0x01-0x08 as record.v1 (chain_id, entry_id, entry_type, global_seq, previous_hash, timestamp, content_hash, signing_key_id), then 0x09 leaf_hash (format-spec §2.0, 128 lowercase hex). Each vector's salt is not in the envelope; it is given so that leaf_hash can be recomputed. reject lists field values a signer MUST refuse and a verifier MUST report unverifiable (record.v1's rules, plus leaf_hash's shape). signatures: ML-DSA-65, pure, deterministic (rnd = 0^32), made in Python with dilithium-py under key (seed_hex; key_id per format-spec §9.6, the vectors' signing_key_id). A v2 verifier verifies over the vector's envelope with the context "aleutian.proof.record.v2": valid true MUST verify, valid false MUST NOT. Computed in Python (scripts/v4-vectors.py), independently of any implementation under test.
